name: Dependency-Track
description: Component analysis platform that tracks known vulnerabilities across a software supply chain using SBOMs.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/data
  {{serviceName}}-frontend:
    image: dependencytrack/frontend:latest
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-frontend
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      API_BASE_URL: "http://{{serviceName}}:8081"
